news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.67 (vs ₹0.78 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.67 (up from ₹0.78 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹283.6m (up 109% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹134.2m (up 170% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 47% (up from 37% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 33% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 66% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Regency Fincorp Limited Approves Directorate Changes
news.body: Regency Fincorp Limited at its board meeting held on February 17, 2026 approved note of the resignation tendered by Kamal Kumar from the position of Non-Executive Independent Director of the company effective closure of business hours on 11 February, 2026. Cessation of directorship of Mr. Sunil Jindal effective 17 February, 2026 due to disqualification under Section 167(1)(b) of the Companies Act, 2013, having remained absent from all meetings of the Board of Directors held during a period of twelve months. Appointment of Sachin Garg as Additional Director in the capacity of Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company, upon recommendation received from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Terms of Appointment: Appointment as Additional Director in the capacity of Non-Executive
